recipe.name: Memsaab's Favourite Pink Gin
recipe.description: A classic Pink Gin elevated with refreshing tonic water, balancing botanical gin and aromatic bitters with a light floral and fruity character.
steps: Coat the inside of a chilled glass with aromatic bitters.
Fill the glass with cubed ice.
Pour in the gin and top up with tonic water.
Stir gently to combine without losing effervescence.
recipe.serving: Served cold in a stemmed glass
